The `store.Memo` struct is defined in `store/memo.go`. The knowledge graph query surfaced the memo cluster but matched mostly frontend proto types, so I confirmed the Go-side references with a direct search. The packages that reference the struct and would need review:

```
store                       (store/driver.go, store/memo.go, store/memo_relation.go, store/memo_share.go)
store/db/mysql              (store/db/mysql/memo.go)
store/db/postgres           (store/db/postgres/memo.go)
store/db/sqlite             (store/db/sqlite/memo.go)
store/test                  (memo_test.go, memo_filter_test.go, memo_relation_test.go, filter_helpers_test.go, migrator_test.go, migrator_upgrade_test.go, user_delete_test.go)
server/router/api/v1        (memo_service.go, memo_service_converter.go, memo_attachment_service.go, memo_relation_service.go, memo_share_service.go, memo_batch_helpers.go, memo_mention_helpers.go, memo_update_helpers.go, reaction_service.go, sse_event_helpers.go, sse_hub_test.go, user_service_notifications.go, common.go)
server/router/api/v1/test   (memo_service_test.go, memo_service_benchmark_test.go, user_service_stats_test.go)
server/router/rss           (rss.go, rss_test.go)
server/router/frontend      (frontend_test.go)
server/runner/memopayload   (runner.go)
server/notification         (email.go)
```

The three `store/db/*` driver packages and `server/router/api/v1` (especially `memo_service_converter.go`, which maps `store.Memo` to the API proto) are the highest-impact review targets for any field change.
